title: Luxury Booking Engine
description: A hotel booking app built with Python and Streamlit. Handles credit card validation, room and spa upgrades, and generates PDF booking confirmations automatically.

title: Horizon Weather
description: An async weather app built with JavaScript and Webpack. Pulls live data from the Visual Crossing API, supports geolocation, and uses a glassmorphism UI.

title: BattleShip
description: A browser-based Battleship game written in object-oriented JavaScript. Includes drag-and-drop ship placement, a randomized CPU opponent, and full Jest test coverage.

title: Student Management System
description: A desktop app for managing student records, built with PyQt6 and MySQL. Handles CRUD operations, live search, and regex-based input validation.

title: Thief Detection Notifier
description: A motion detection system built with Python and OpenCV. Buffers frames in memory and uses background threads to email a snapshot the moment it detects movement.

title: Django Job Application Portal
description: A career portal built with Django. Sends automated email confirmations, includes an admin dashboard with CSV exports, and runs on a SQLite backend.

title: ODE Solver
description: A visual solver for ordinary differential equations. Uses SymPy for exact symbolic solutions and Plotly for animated, frame-by-frame plots, with Euler, Heun, and RK4 methods available in a Streamlit interface.

title: NEXUS Admin Dashboard
description: A responsive admin dashboard combining CSS Grid for structure with Flexbox for alignment. Dark mode throughout, with glassmorphism accents on the panels.

title: Glassy Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A classic Tic-Tac-Toe game rebuilt with vanilla JavaScript, using the module pattern and factory functions to keep game state and UI logic separate.

title: Glassmorphic Todo List
description: A task manager with local storage persistence, built with object-oriented JavaScript and bundled with Webpack using ES6 modules.

title: Midnight Library
description: A book-tracking app built with object-oriented JavaScript. Uses native HTML5 modals and the Constraint Validation API for real-time form checks.

title: Midnight Lounge
description: A restaurant landing page with tab-based navigation and dynamic DOM updates, built with Webpack for a modular JavaScript structure.

title: Weather Forecast Dashboard
description: A multi-day forecast dashboard pulling from the OpenWeatherMap API. Built with Streamlit and Plotly, with spline charts for temperature trends and a grid for daily conditions.

title: Binary Search Tree
description: A balanced binary search tree implemented from scratch in ES6. Covers node insertion, deletion, and BFS/DFS traversal, with full Jest test coverage.

title: HashMap
description: A hash map implemented from scratch in ES6, handling collisions with separate chaining and auto-resizing based on a set load factor.

title: Knight's Travails
description: An algorithm that finds the shortest path between two squares on a chessboard using breadth-first search and a queue-based structure.

title: Weather Data API
description: A Flask REST API for querying historical climate data from the European Climate Assessment dataset, with clean JSON endpoints and automatic unit conversion.

title: Tour Event Scraper
description: A scraping service that checks for new concert listings on a schedule, deduplicates results with SQLite, and sends an email alert when it finds a new tour date.

title: News Email Automation
description: A script that pulls topic-specific articles from NewsAPI and sends a formatted daily digest by email over Gmail SMTP.

title: Batch Invoice Generator
description: A batch tool that reads invoice data from Excel files with pandas and generates print-ready PDF invoices with fpdf2.

title: Archive Manager
description: A desktop app for compressing and extracting ZIP archives, built with Python and FreeSimpleGUI, with native file dialogs and a tabbed interface.

title: Wordle CLI
description: A terminal clone of Wordle with color-coded feedback, dictionary validation via pyenchant, and a persistent win-streak tracker.

title: Glassmorphism Sign-Up Form
description: A sign-up form built with HTML5 and CSS3, using backdrop filters and pure CSS pseudo-classes for real-time validation — no JavaScript required.

title: Meridian Watches
description: A landing page for a luxury watch brand concept, built with Flexbox and a gold-and-slate color palette to give it a boutique, high-end feel.

title: Rock Paper Scissors Battle
description: A first-to-five Rock Paper Scissors game with a dark UI, built in vanilla JavaScript to handle scoring, game state, and randomized opponent moves.

title: Modern Calculator
description: A responsive calculator built with vanilla JavaScript. Handles edge cases like division by zero and formats results in scientific notation when needed.

title: Etch-a-Sketch
description: A browser recreation of the classic drawing toy, with a dynamically generated grid, custom drawing modes, a color picker, and touch support for mobile.

title: Web Automation Engine
description: A desktop automation tool with a Tkinter GUI that drives browser actions through Selenium. Uses explicit waits and background threading so the UI stays responsive during login, form submission, and file tasks.

title: Flask Job Application Form
description: A job application form built with Flask and SQLAlchemy, with backend validation, automated email notifications, and a dark UI.

title: Django Restaurant Menu & Digital Ordering
description: A digital ordering system for restaurants, built with Django. Manages the cart in the session, generates QR codes for tables, and gives staff a live inventory dashboard through the Django admin.
